title: All the Celebrities Flocking to Watch Knicks vs. Spurs in the NBA Finals
text:
Taylor Swift, Cardi B, Timothée Chalamet, Adam Sandler, Spike Lee, Ben Stiller, and more celebrities have shown up to watch the NBA Finals.
Este Haim, Taylor Swift, and Mariska Hargitay attend Game Four of the 2026 NBA Finals on June 10, 2026 in NYC.aren’t anything new, a Knicks Finals game has a different kind of appeal — especially when it’s the team’s first NBA Finals appearance since 1999.
, the showdown has brought together fans and famous faces from across industries to the witness the historic battle nearly three decades in the making. June 11, 2026 Elsewhere in the building that night were Timothée Chalamet and Kylie Jenner. The couple coordinated in matching Chrome Hearts blue denim looks with bright orange crosses. Of course, courtside mainstays and superfans Ben Stiller, Spike Lee, Tracy Morgan, Fat Joe, Larry David, and Adam Sandler have been spotted.
Jay-Z, Tina Fey, Pete Davidson, and DJ Khaled were also in attendance in the past week. So was Taylor Swift and Haim Sisters Sport 'Stevie Knicks' Shirts at Knicks Final Gameof “Wu‐Tang Clan Ain’t Nuthing ta F’ Wit,” “Method Man” and more in an attempt to revive Knicks fans following a dismal first half as the Spurs entered the third quarter with a huge lead. At the end of the performance, Method Man prophesized: ‘Knicks in 5.
’ It must have worked, as the Knicks rallied to defeat the Spurs 107-106 in a historic comeback in the second half. This article was published on June 11, 2026, at 12:04 a.m. ET and will be updated throughout the 2026 NBA Finals.
